title: Debian 13 GNOME overview
caption: Debian 13 (trixie), GNOME Shell 48.7, kernel 7.3.0-rc4 (t26) on the built-in 1904x3040 panel at scale 2. The helper's app (shown under its earlier name, Tablet Settings) (Systems page) and a terminal with tb323fu-ctl battery, refresh and gpu output in the activities overview.

title: Debian 13 in landscape
caption: Debian 13 GNOME rotated to landscape (3040x1904, transform 90) with the helper's app (earlier name Tablet Settings) on its Performance page: GPU profile, frequency limits and live temperatures.

title: Tablet quick settings
caption: GNOME quick settings on Debian 13 with the Tablet extension menu open: battery state and charger, charge limit (60/80/100 %), bypass charging, refresh-rate mode (Adaptive, fixed 60 Hz, always 120 Hz) and the torch. Wi-Fi network name blanked.

title: Helper: Battery
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Battery page: charge limit 80 %, bypass charging, live status (state, charge, power, current, voltage, temperature, health, cycle count) and the charger's contract and measured input.

title: Helper: Display
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Display page: adaptive refresh rate (120 Hz, slowing to 60 then 30 Hz while the screen is still; now 30 Hz) and its timing preset.

title: Helper: Performance
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Performance page: Adreno GPU profile, per-profile frequency limits, surface/CPU/GPU temperatures and throttling state.

title: Helper: Torch & LED Ring
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Torch & LED Ring page: rear torch and its brightness, LED ring charge indicator, brightness and the low-battery (red) threshold.

title: Helper: USB
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. USB page: wake from USB keyboards and mice, and USB developer mode (network link and root console over the cable).

title: Helper: Emergency Key
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Emergency Key page: holding both volume keys for 10 s restarts into Android.

title: Helper: Systems (multiboot)
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Systems page: the installed roots (Debian on UFS and SD, Arch Linux ARM, Fedora 44, NixOS 26.11, SteamOS, Ubuntu 26.04.1) with one-shot restart; the SD Debian root is flagged as having no sound.

title: Helper: Android
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Android page: Android's boot image is ready in boot_b (its hash), optional authentication, and Restart into Android.

title: Helper: Diagnostics
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Diagnostics page: stored crash records, the last boot's state and the diagnostics export (personal data removed).

title: Helper: About
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. About page: helper and app version, running kernel, features available, firmware manifest and kernel updates (GitHub Releases channel, check now, install a kernel from a file).

title: Helper: Install Kernel from File
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. Install Kernel from File: what the helper found in a picked Image.gz (release, build banner, shared modules) and the warning that a local build is tried like an update and rolled back if it does not start twice.

title: Helper: Battery (dark style)
caption: Debian 13, kernel t31, portrait at 200 %. The Battery page with GNOME's dark style.

title: tb323fu-ctl boot list and thermal
caption: GNOME Terminal on Debian 13, kernel 7.3.0-rc4 (t26): tb323fu-ctl boot list (multiboot roots), tb323fu-ctl thermal (14 board sensors, no throttling) and systemd-analyze (6.3 s to graphical.target).

title: tb323fu-ctl battery, refresh, gpu
caption: GNOME Terminal on Debian 13: tb323fu-ctl battery (charge limit 80 %, charging), refresh (adaptive 30/60/120 Hz policy) and gpu (profile and frequency floors).

title: Debian 13 About
caption: GNOME Settings About page on Debian 13 (trixie): 14.8 GiB memory, 507.4 GB disk; the processor name is not reported.
